notes.title: Bug Fixes and Skill Adjustments
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug Fixes and Adjustments[/h1]
1.Fixed an issue where certain monsters would not trigger "Homing Arrow: Thunder Needle"
2.Fixed an issue where legendary skills could not be reselected in the hideout
3.Adjusted Korean translations
4.Fixed a possible error when teleporting in the 2-3 Desert Arena map

[h1]Skill Adjustments[/h1]
1.Extra arrows from Triple Shot (Barrage Sweep/Beam Arrow) can now stack Ignite and Fireblast

3.Increased the duration and damage of "Homing Arrow: Thunder Needle"
4.Adjusted the damage of "Triple Shot: Beam Arrow"

notes.title: The first version's final boss added (optional difficulty)
notes.notes:
[h1]Initial Version Final Boss[/h1]
After several adjustments to the BOSS difficulty and player abilities, many players feel that the current version's difficulty is quite comfortable and allows for a smooth progression.
However, some players believe the current version is too easy.
To accommodate all players,
[b]I have decided to add the initial version of the final boss to the level for players to challenge,
but players can choose which difficulty version they want to fight[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743925/32361345b6a5cc8c832debb8cc9678c10bf9ea11.jpg[/img]
Choosing the route will directly adjust the BOSS difficulty.

Although this is the final boss from the initial version (game's first day),
the difficulty is not as high as it was on the first day.
This is because, while the BOSS’s battle rhythm, attack variations, and damage output have all been adjusted back to the initial version,
the player’s performance was significantly enhanced in the 2/9 update,
especially in terms of counterattacks and dodging.
So, while the BOSS has become more difficult,
the player has also become much stronger compared to the initial version.
Therefore, even if you choose the initial version of the final boss,
the difficulty won’t be as hard as it was on the first day!

[h1]BUG Fixes and Skill Adjustments[/h1]

1.Adjusted collision between player and BOSS
2.Added difficulty options in the final map of the third stage, allowing players to choose which final boss version to fight
3.Adjusted the combo thunderball tracking behavior for the BOSS in the second stage: A-grade Psionic Hunter Knight: Thunderhammer
4.Adjusted text size and positioning for the three-choice skills
5.Adjusted explosion damage after triggering Firestorm for Explosive Arrow
6.Adjusted crit chance for Lucky Strike in Triple Shot
7.Adjusted damage and crit chance for Barrage in Triple Shot
8.Adjusted damage and crit chance for Laser Arrow in Triple Shot

notes.title: Some bug fixes and game adjustments
notes.notes:

TAB skill slots - Fixed the issue where players could not view skills beyond the second page in the skill tab
When choosing one of three skills, players will be notified if the skill is max level

Fixed the issue where the second level boss still dealt damage to the player after death (Floor Dash skill)
Adjusted descriptions in the settings options
BUFF Thunder Chain series skills - Each time the lightning bounces, damage increases and it has a chance to crit / Thunder explosion damage increased

notes.title: Day One Update
notes.notes:
[h1]2-5 BOSS Mavis[/h1]

Adjusted the double throwing dagger counterattack to fix an issue where one dagger would hit the other. Now, both daggers will be judged for counterattack simultaneously.
Removed the lingering lightning damage effect on the ground after the Phase 2 dash.
Adjusted the overall combat rhythm by slowing down the pace and skill transitions, especially before using "Teleporting Dagger" and the start of "Lightning Dash."
Reduced HP: Phase 1 from 30,000 to 25,000, Phase 2 from 40,000 to 30,000.
[h1]3-1 Elite Enemies & Final Boss[/h1]

Adjusted the visual effects, timing, and damage of the inner and outer ring attack patterns.
Tweaked the pacing of skill transitions and animation speed.
Fixed an issue where the boss could get stuck due to environmental factors in the final boss arena.
[h1]Others[/h1]

For the tutorial that prompts players to press TAB when entering the hideout for the first time, a permanent equipment UI (TAB prompt) has been added to the upper right corner.
Fixed the counterattack detection for the arrows shot by the "Demonic Archer" in stage 3-1.
Fixed an issue where the water flask might not be fully refilled when returning to the hideout.
Fixed a problem in the Little Verna tutorial mode where the skill tutorial could get stuck.
Additionally, many players provided bug reports and game suggestions on the first day,
and I am still actively fixing and addressing these issues!
A huge thank you to all the players who joined on launch day!
I sincerely apologize if you encountered any bugs,
and I will do my best to fix them!

This update mainly focuses on improving the pacing of mid-to-late-game boss battles.
After this update, the difficulty curve of the game should feel more reasonable and smoother,
especially addressing the sudden difficulty spike from 2-5 onward.
Furthermore, adjustments to the inner and outer ring mechanics should make it easier for players to identify safe zones.

notes.title: DEMO Version Update
notes.notes:
"Psionic Sentry: Infinite" is launching its Early Access version soon!

The latest DEMO update includes the following changes:

Controller Button Layout Adjustments
Based on feedback from the demo version and multiple exhibitions,
we have temporarily adjusted the button layout to better match player preferences.

Invincibility During Skill Casting
Normal attacks can be canceled with counters/dodges, preventing situations
where players "see" an enemy attack but are unable to react due to attack animations.
However, skill casting has unavoidable end-lag, often causing such issues.
To address this, we’ve introduced a new mechanic: "Invincibility During Skill Casting",
ensuring smoother combat flow and encouraging players to use skills more frequently.

Korean Translation Added
Our backend data shows a significant number of Korean players, so we have added Korean language support.

Resolution Support

4K resolution support added
Ultra-wide 21:9 resolution support added
Enemy Adjustments
Tweaked the abilities and stats of certain elite enemies.

This update ensures that the DEMO version aligns with the upcoming Early Access Level 1 content.
The Early Access version of "Psionic Sentry: Infinite" is coming very soon!
We appreciate your support and look forward to your feedback!
